n396f8ddb73.headline: Georgian National University SEU to set up ₹1,300 crore campus in Andhra Pradesh
n396f8ddb73.summary: Georgian National University SEU will invest ₹1,300 crore in Andhra Pradesh to build a campus offering global education, skills and employment opportunities.
n396f8ddb73.why: Large private education investments can create local employment and foreign direct investment. Universities operating across borders are part of the wider services trade.

nae5bb16ebb.headline: Paulson raised more than 400-450 million euros from the Athens Stock Exchange in a month
nae5bb16ebb.summary: Paulson raised more than 400 to 450 million euros from the Athens Stock Exchange in a month through three pre-agreed packages and other transactions. Some transactions passed under the radar of investors.
nae5bb16ebb.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and large placements by investors can affect liquidity and pricing in local shares.

n62625eb4cb.headline: Third potential rival to Eurostar emerges
n62625eb4cb.summary: Gemini, chaired by Labour peer Lord Berkeley, says it wants to operate trains connecting London with Paris and Brussels. It is the third potential Eurostar rival to emerge.
n62625eb4cb.why: Eurostar runs the main passenger rail service between London and continental Europe, so new competitors could affect its pricing and market share.

n0e978042eb.headline: Ghana committed to IMF Programme, advancing Debt Restructuring – Finance Minister
n0e978042eb.summary: Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson reaffirmed the government's commitment to meeting conditions of the IMF programme and completing its debt restructuring.
n0e978042eb.why: The IMF programme and debt restructuring determine Ghana's access to international financing and the path of its sovereign debt obligations to creditors.

n94f8cd139f.headline: UK private sector growth rises to six month high in March
n94f8cd139f.summary: Activity across the UK private sector grew at its fastest pace in six months in March, driven by strong trading in the services industry, according to new data.
n94f8cd139f.why: Private sector activity surveys offer an early read on the health of the UK economy, which influences Bank of England policy expectations and sterling.

n7bab783c58.headline: Klarna IPO filing spurs hope of British fintech listings
n7bab783c58.summary: Klarna's upcoming US initial public offering could help unlock a pipeline of British fintech flotations after a barren period for new technology listings, an executive told Reuters.
n7bab783c58.why: Klarna is a Swedish buy-now-pay-later and payments company whose listing is seen as a bellwether for fintech IPO appetite.

n42fcd648f2.headline: ECB board member makes case for more interest rate cuts
n42fcd648f2.summary: ECB board member Piero Cipollone said the case for another interest rate cut is strengthening. Other members of the Governing Council remain more cautious.
n42fcd648f2.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area. Its rate decisions influence euro yields, borrowing costs and the currency.

n7076dafa00.headline: UAE: Gold prices slip in early trade on first trading day of the week
n7076dafa00.summary: Gold was trading at $3,022.39 per ounce globally, down 0.62% in early trade on the first trading day of the week.
n7076dafa00.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a benchmark for risk sentiment, and its price is quoted globally in US dollars.

ne8058f73c2.headline: Rupee recovers 2025 losses, surges 31 paise to close at 85.67 against US dollar
ne8058f73c2.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened for a seventh straight session, closing at 85.67 against the US dollar after gaining 31 paise. Positive domestic equity trends supported the currency.
ne8058f73c2.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects importers, exporters and foreign investors holding Indian assets. Currency moves influence inflation and corporate earnings for companies with dollar exposure.

n1e049d0af5.headline: Canada election 2025: What you need to know
n1e049d0af5.summary: Canadians will vote in parliamentary elections on April 28. The campaign is taking place amid anxiety over Donald Trump's tariffs and annexation threats.
n1e049d0af5.why: Canada is a major trading partner of the US, so elections and policy shifts in Ottawa affect cross-border trade, the Canadian dollar and sectors such as energy and autos.

n6e40c9923f.headline: UK finance minister says she will stick to fiscal rules
n6e40c9923f.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves said Britain will stick to its fiscal rules despite global upheaval. This raises the prospect of thousands of public sector job cuts in this week's budget update.
n6e40c9923f.why: Fiscal rules set limits on government borrowing and spending, shaping gilt yields and the outlook for UK growth and public finances.

n8fa8f4d995.headline: French maneuvers on Piazza Affari, politics moves in.
n8fa8f4d995.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Antonio Tajani has expressed concern about the situation on the Milan Stock Exchange. He fears Italian companies may list abroad.
n8fa8f4d995.why: Piazza Affari is the Milan Stock Exchange, Italy's main equity market, and listings abroad would affect its size and liquidity.

n15f71880fd.headline: Trump targets countries that buy oil and gas from Venezuela with 25% tariff
n15f71880fd.summary: President Donald Trump announced that the United States will impose a 25% secondary tariff on countries that purchase oil or gas from Venezuela. The measure targets buyers of Venezuelan energy.
n15f71880fd.why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest proven oil reserves, so restrictions on its buyers affect global crude flows and prices. Tariffs on energy purchasers can reshape trade routes and refinery sourcing.
n15f71880fd.why_moved: The announced 25% tariff on buyers of Venezuelan oil and gas raises the cost of purchasing Venezuelan barrels, which can reduce demand and tighten crude flows.

nf37eeb0675.headline: Russian strikes injure scores in Ukraine as US and Kremlin officials meet for ceasefire talks
nf37eeb0675.summary: A US delegation met Kremlin negotiators in Saudi Arabia on Monday as the Trump administration pushes for progress toward a ceasefire. Russian strikes injured scores of people in Ukraine, including children.
nf37eeb0675.why: The Russia-Ukraine war affects European energy, grain and defence markets, and ceasefire progress shapes sanctions and investor risk sentiment.

n0c4907ef4f.headline: Borse Frankfurt-News:  Weekly outlook
n0c4907ef4f.summary: Frankfurt's DAX has benefited for weeks from additional future German spending. US tariffs are now back in focus, and seasonality may argue against a real trend reversal.
n0c4907ef4f.why: The DAX is Germany's benchmark index of the largest listed companies, and its exporters are sensitive to US trade policy.

impacts.name: DAX
impacts.why: US tariff risks are cited as a factor in the outlook for Germany's benchmark index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n67b5a8eda8.headline: Japan's factory activity declines accelerate - PMI
n67b5a8eda8.summary: Japan's factory activity fell at the fastest pace in a year in March, dragged down by lower production and new orders, a private-sector survey showed.
n67b5a8eda8.why: The manufacturing PMI is a leading indicator of industrial output and economic momentum in Japan, the world's fourth-largest economy.

n3e4f8b5b9a.headline: The top 4 things you need to know now
n3e4f8b5b9a.summary: Potential US tariffs could lead pharmaceutical companies to gradually pull out of Ireland, according to the report. The warning is part of a roundup of key news.
n3e4f8b5b9a.why: Ireland hosts large pharmaceutical manufacturing operations and is an important export base for the sector into the United States.

n0c6d542490.headline: Central Bank announces new consumer protection code
n0c6d542490.summary: The Central Bank has published a new consumer protection code to modernise the rules that businesses must follow when dealing with consumers. The code is aimed at updating existing standards.
n0c6d542490.why: The Central Bank of Ireland regulates financial firms operating in Ireland, and its conduct rules apply to banks, insurers and other providers.

na895fd1518.headline: Trump executive order threatens small business lending in Philadelphia
na895fd1518.summary: A Trump executive order could threaten the Community Development Financial Institutions Fund, which supports lending to low-income entrepreneurs. Without federal support, the system could collapse, according to the report.
na895fd1518.why: CDFI lenders provide credit to underserved businesses and communities that mainstream banks often do not serve.

nc4fa57382e.headline: RWE:  Elliott wants greater clarity on share buybacks
nc4fa57382e.summary: Activist fund Elliott welcomed a more disciplined investment approach unveiled by RWE. It said it wants greater clarity on the company's shareholder return and buyback plans.
nc4fa57382e.why: RWE is a German power and renewables utility, and buyback policy affects shareholder returns and capital allocation.

n15897b19b5.headline: The United Laboratories and Novo Nordisk announce exclusive license agreement for UBT251, a GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple receptor agonist
n15897b19b5.summary: The United Laboratories and Novo Nordisk announced an exclusive license agreement for UBT251, a GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple receptor agonist. The deal was announced on 24 March 2025.
n15897b19b5.why: Novo Nordisk is a Danish drugmaker and a leader in GLP-1 obesity and diabetes treatments, so licensing deals in this class are closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: The exclusive license gives Novo Nordisk rights to a triple receptor agonist in its obesity and diabetes pipeline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nebaf5a49a0.headline: TSX futures rise on reports of moderate US approach to tariffs
nebaf5a49a0.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index rose on Monday, mirroring gains on Wall Street. Media reports said the US approach to fresh tariffs is likely to be more moderate than feared.
nebaf5a49a0.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity index, and it is heavily exposed to trade with the United States.
nebaf5a49a0.why_moved: Media reports suggested the US approach to fresh tariffs would be more moderate, and Wall Street gains were mirrored in Canadian futures.

n12b6feabc2.headline: Euro zone economy growth accelerates to seven-month high
n12b6feabc2.summary: Euro zone business activity expanded at its fastest pace in seven months in March, helped by an easing manufacturing downturn but held back by slower services growth.
n12b6feabc2.why: Business activity surveys are timely gauges of economic momentum that central banks and investors monitor closely.

nf7d7e3b611.headline: Golar LNG signs finance lease agreements for FLNG Gimi
nf7d7e3b611.summary: Golar LNG has entered into finance lease agreements with a consortium of leading Chinese leasing companies. The leases refinance the existing debt facility for the FLNG Gimi floating liquefaction vessel.
nf7d7e3b611.why: Golar LNG operates floating liquefied natural gas facilities, and refinancing of project debt affects its funding costs and balance sheet.

ncf481d300e.headline: Ola S1 Gen 3 Electric Scooters Deliveries Begin Amidst Registration Woes  - ZigWheels
ncf481d300e.summary: Ola Electric has started deliveries of its Gen 3 S1 electric scooters in India, but the company is still resolving registration bottlenecks.
ncf481d300e.why: Ola Electric is an Indian electric two-wheeler maker, and its delivery and registration progress drives its near-term sales and revenue.

ndd988b035d.headline: Dun & Bradstreet Enters Into a Definitive Agreement To Be Acquired by Clearlake Capital Group
ndd988b035d.summary: Dun & Bradstreet shareholders will receive $9.15 per share in cash in a transaction valued at $7.7 billion, according to a definitive agreement with Clearlake Capital Group.
ndd988b035d.why: Dun & Bradstreet is a US business data and analytics company, and take-private deals by private equity firms like Clearlake are a common form of large-cap M&A.
ndd988b035d.why_moved: A definitive agreement to acquire the company for cash at $9.15 per share, valued at $7.7 billion, was announced.

nf12f8c088b.headline: Congress Is Searching for Trillions of Dollars in Cuts. Will the Oil Industry’s Tax Breaks Skate By?
nf12f8c088b.summary: With a $4.5 trillion fight over tax cuts looming in Congress, the oil and gas industry wants to protect billions of dollars in existing tax benefits and secure new ones.
nf12f8c088b.why: Tax treatment of oil and gas producers affects their cash flows, capital spending and returns, which matter to energy investors.

nda3c9578af.headline: China calls for global business to ‘resist protectionism’ as American executives gather in Beijing
nda3c9578af.summary: Premier Li Qiang told a gathering in Beijing that China is prepared for possible unexpected shocks, while calling on global business to resist protectionism.
nda3c9578af.why: Beijing's stance on trade barriers affects foreign companies operating in China and the global supply chains that depend on US-China commerce.

nb76d66b8e8.headline: Factories suffer worst performance in 18 months
nb76d66b8e8.summary: Factory performance has fallen to its weakest in 18 months, a headache for Chancellor Rachel Reeves as she prepares to face downgraded economic forecasts.
nb76d66b8e8.why: Manufacturing data is a key gauge of UK economic health and shapes expectations for Bank of England policy and government fiscal decisions.

n2670b2a5e8.headline: Indonesia stocks tumble on growth, state firm ownership concerns
n2670b2a5e8.summary: Indonesian stocks tumbled on Monday, extending a rout as investors grew jittery over the country's economic outlook. Concerns about state-firm ownership were also cited.
n2670b2a5e8.why: Jakarta's stock exchange is Indonesia's main equity market, and its moves reflect investor confidence in Southeast Asia's largest economy.
n2670b2a5e8.why_moved: Investors became jittery about the economic outlook and concerns over state-firm ownership, extending a sell-off in the market.

na75ad05772.headline: China welcomes Apple, Qualcomm, AstraZeneca CEOs to The China Development Forum
na75ad05772.summary: Beijing assured US and other foreign business leaders at the China Development Forum that it will keep opening its market to investment and collaboration. Apple, Qualcomm and AstraZeneca CEOs attended.
na75ad05772.why: Apple, Qualcomm and AstraZeneca have large China revenue and supply-chain exposure, so market access policy matters to their results.

n9d36358e6a.headline: In good spirits after hints of tariff retreat
n9d36358e6a.summary: A market preview says the week began with somewhat conciliatory messages from U.S. President Donald Trump on tariffs, lifting sentiment in European and global markets.
n9d36358e6a.why: Tariff policy affects trade flows, corporate margins and equity valuations across major economies, so signals of a retreat move global markets.
n9d36358e6a.why_moved: Conciliatory comments from the U.S. president on tariffs eased trade-war concerns. Lower expected tariffs typically support equities, especially export-exposed sectors.

n61d61df40c.headline: Mirae Asset launches first target-date ETF with S&P
n61d61df40c.summary: Mirae Asset Global Investments introduced its first target-date exchange-traded fund on Monday, aiming to provide retirees with a retirement-focused investment product.
n61d61df40c.why: Mirae Asset is one of South Korea's largest asset managers, and target-date funds are a major vehicle for retirement savings.

n36ab8e0cda.headline: AI chip startup FuriosaAI turns down $800 million acquisition offer from Meta
n36ab8e0cda.summary: South Korean AI chipmaker FuriosaAI has reportedly turned down an acquisition offer from Meta worth $800 million.
n36ab8e0cda.why: Meta is a major US technology company investing heavily in AI infrastructure, and AI chip startups are key targets for such deals.

nbc9048bcfe.headline: Cars set to get costlier from April as cos announce price hikes
nbc9048bcfe.summary: Automakers including Maruti Suzuki, Mahindra & Mahindra and Hyundai have announced price hikes effective from April. The companies cite rising input costs and operational expenses.
nbc9048bcfe.why: Maruti Suzuki, Mahindra and Hyundai are among India's largest carmakers, so their pricing decisions shape the country's auto sales and margins.

impacts.name: Maruti Suzuki India
impacts.why: Maruti Suzuki is raising car prices from April because of higher input costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n59caa693f2.headline: Signs of early recovery of Chinas diamond industry spark optimism for Indian exports: GJEPC
n59caa693f2.summary: Early signs of recovery in China's diamond market, the second largest after the US, have sparked optimism in the Indian diamond industry. The Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council was cited.
n59caa693f2.why: China is one of the largest diamond consumer markets, and India is a major diamond cutting and polishing hub. Demand changes in China affect Indian gem exports.

n7be728cc53.headline: Grappling with  provincial reforms
n7be728cc53.summary: Analysts say the centre and provinces must engage in meaningful dialogue on a new National Finance Commission award. The aim is a fairer and more efficient revenue-sharing arrangement.
n7be728cc53.why: The National Finance Commission (NFC) award determines how federal revenue is divided among Pakistan's provinces. It affects provincial budgets and the fiscal outlook of the federation.

nffe292d094.headline: Taxes, trade, tariffs among key topics for federal leaders on first full campaign day
nffe292d094.summary: Federal party leaders spent their first full day on the election campaign trail discussing taxes, transfers, tariffs and trade.
nffe292d094.why: Canada's trade relationship with the United States and federal fiscal policy are central to investor views on the Canadian economy.

n3aaeefc0ff.headline: Canadian and U.S. stocks surge higher Monday on latest tariff headlines
n3aaeefc0ff.summary: Canadian and US stock markets rallied to start the week after reports that new US tariffs due April 2 may be narrower than expected. Trade headlines dominated trading.
n3aaeefc0ff.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and tariff expectations strongly influence both Canadian and US equity markets.
n3aaeefc0ff.why_moved: Reports that a new round of US tariffs due April 2 might be narrower than first expected eased trade fears and lifted stocks.

n785e009e35.headline: Canadian clothiers sad to see Bay's decline but say they long ago adjusted to new era
n785e009e35.summary: Canadian clothing designers say they adjusted long ago to the decline of The Bay, despite past high-profile collaborations with the retailer. The decline marks a shift in Canadian retail.
n785e009e35.why: Hudson's Bay is a historic Canadian department store chain, and its decline reflects broader pressure on traditional retail and apparel brands.

n70a2ac6960.headline: Tariff talks loom over B.C. housing market, but are fears overblown?
n70a2ac6960.summary: An economist says tariffs may spook homebuyers in British Columbia, but housing market fundamentals remain steady. The comments address fears around the trade dispute.
n70a2ac6960.why: Housing market conditions affect Canadian banks, mortgage lending and household wealth, and tariffs can shift buyer sentiment.
